components.name: Primary button — proposed reference
components.description: Design-stage preview only, not an app component: 48px primary action with a 14/22px label, system font fallback, System light/dark response and visible keyboard focus. Literal values resolve the documentation tokens; no app runtime theme is assumed.
components.css: .ds-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; box-sizing: border-box; height: 48px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #285BCB; color: #FFFFFF; font: 500 14px/22px system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: center; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1); } .ds-primary:hover { background: #214EAF; } .ds-primary:active { background: #1B4195; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #285BCB; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-primary:disabled { background: #E9EEF5; color: #657389; cursor: default; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-primary { background: #9EBEFF; color: #101A2A; } .ds-primary:hover { background: #B7CEFF; } .ds-primary:active { background: #83A9F0; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline-color: #9EBEFF; } .ds-primary:disabled { background: #253143; color: #91A1B8; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-primary { transition: none; } }

components.name: Labeled input — proposed reference
components.description: Design-stage preview only, not an app component: persistent wrapping label, 44px field, system font fallback and logical alignment that inherits LTR/RTL. System light/dark response; not evidence of full localization.
components.html: <label class="ds-field">Project name<input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="Enter project name"></label>
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; max-inline-size: 640px; color: #18212F; font: 500 14px/22px system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: start; } .ds-input { box-sizing: border-box; inline-size: 100%; min-inline-size: 0; height: 44px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid #77869A; border-radius: 8px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #18212F; font: 400 14px/22px system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: start; transition: border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #18212F; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #285BCB; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #536173; opacity: 1; } .ds-input:disabled { background: #E9EEF5; color: #657389; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-field { color: #EDF2F8; } .ds-input { background: #171E28; color: #EDF2F8; border-color: #7889A3; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #EDF2F8; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline-color: #9EBEFF; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #B1BED0; } .ds-input:disabled { background: #253143; color: #91A1B8; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-input { transition: none; } }

narrative.overview:
Version 1 proposal, 17 October 2026. **Design documentation and reference only; this system is not applied to the running app.** The supplied SoloDesk logo and confirmed product constraints are binding. The user selected a familiar productivity-app direction, with **Linear, Notion and GitHub** as quality references, **spacious controls**, **light and dark themes with System default**, and **English/Arabic with full RTL**. Exact token/font/geometry recommendations remain reviewable; no legal or financial policy is decided by visual design.

SoloDesk should feel calm, precise and dependable over a full working day. The graphite-and-silver identity comes from the logo. Blue identifies actions and selection; semantic colors communicate meaningful conditions. Familiar sidebar navigation, accessible forms, stable tables and readable documents carry the product. Avoid decorative chrome that competes with work. Borrow reference products' consistency and care, not their brand assets or layouts wholesale.
dos: Do preserve the supplied logo and use accessible text plus a light plate when the original cannot read on dark chrome.
Do keep spacious spacing, readable data and clear single primary actions; use shared Tailwind/shadcn tokens instead of feature-specific palettes.
Do give English and Arabic equal behavior, focus, typography, validation and document quality.
Do separate local durability, cloud acknowledgment, review, issuance, delivery and settlement states.
Do show currency, exact source/version, formula and as-of context wherever interpretation depends on them.
Do update tokens, component contracts, screen map, contrast evidence and relevant PR QA together.
donts: Don't invent revenue, compliance, availability, free-service capacity or pricing claims in the reference or empty state.
Don't replace OS window controls with decorative renderer buttons, hide actions behind drag/hover alone, or let a custom titlebar block native interaction.
Don't reinterpret immutable issued documents as editable forms or retry unknown financial outcomes as new commands.
Don't add AI product features, install packages, provision services or implement the app as a side effect of this design specification.
Don't treat a static/generated mockup as proof of accessibility, RTL, security, persistence or financial correctness.
